question_en: Build a full comparative capability matrix of ATT&CK intrusion sets Kimsuky, APT28, APT29, Lazarus Group and Sandworm Team: for each, list attributed malware, tool count, and the exact number of distinct attack patterns it uses; then rank the five sets by technique breadth and name every technique used by all five simultaneously.
